newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Chinese president to visit Russia April 22-26.
newsitem.headline: Chinese president to visit Russia April 22-26.

text.p: Chinese President Jiang Zemin will visit Russia from April 22 to 26 for talks with Russian President Boris Yeltsin, the Kremlin said on Thursday.

The presidential press service said Jiang was expected to sign an accord with Yeltsin and the presidents of the Central Asian states of Tajikistan, Kazakhstan and Kyrgyzstan on reducing border forces.

Jiang will also discuss political and economic cooperation between Russia and China. Chinese Foreign Minister Qian Qichen visited Moscow last month to prepare for Jiang's arrival although no date for the trip had then been announced.

Russia is trying to build up relations gradually with China and has been looking to the East at a time when relations with Western governments are strained by differences over NATO's plans to expand eastwards despite Moscow's opposition.
Russia and China formed a strong alliance in the early 1950s but it degenerated into bitter rivalry for leadership of the communist world and led to border clashes in the late 1960s.
Relations have been gradually improving since the late 1980s. Both China and Russia say they are keen to develop a strategic partnership but rule out the renewal of any military or political bloc.
